content_fields.title: Test for input validation on a server
content_fields.description: Validate the request parameter on the server against a closed set before it reaches any downstream call.
content_fields.finding: The `parameters` query string is accepted with no validation and handed to a shell command builder.
criteria: The parameter is typed as an enum or carries an explicit pattern and length constraint.
Validation happens server side and does not rely on the client.
An out-of-set value returns 422 before the handler body runs.
